purpose: Finite diagnosis of sealed v77 failure: scalar bias versus spatially varying errors. No model rerun, fitting, corrected output, source admission or navigation.
data: all 1267 saved pairs, seven seen development sequences; old front .40m installation, not current original-four .20m configuration
domain: unchanged each-eye finite GT .5–3m, static CAD excluded; predictions outside range remain scored; positive finite prediction ratio separately counted
statistics: per full frame signed error p10,p50,p90, abs p90, pred/GT p10,p50,p90; >.15 over/under counts, pixel denominator; LR median ratio difference is unpaired image-domain diagnostic, NOT corresponding surface scale consistency
stop: One complete read-only analysis. No thresholds tuned, no inferred calibration applied. If spatial/temporal/group variation exists, cannot justify a universal online scalar from these GT diagnostics alone.
outputs: frame-level counts and equal-frame summaries, source hashes, fixed B65 47s prior example retained
